_readme: Installed as .github/zethus.config.json in YOUR repo; edit it there. Every key is optional: the scripts and agent fall back to repository evidence, then ask. Key names match Amphion's .claude/amphion.config.json wherever they overlap (gates, branchModel, docSync), and the scripts read that file when this one is absent.
_branchModelReadme: base is the default base, the integration branch. bases maps a branch name or glob to that branch's own base, for a long-term-branch workflow, e.g. {"epic/search": "develop", "search/*": "epic/search"}: an exact name beats a glob, the most specific glob beats the rest, and a base from the map has its own base, up to base. Leave it empty and every branch's base is base. See docs/per-branch-bases.md.
_oneOffReadme: The one-off path (run-one-off skill) needs no config. confirm:true adds one picked confirmation before a one-off command runs; false (the default) runs under the host's own permission prompt alone, since the person asking is already the go-ahead.
_identityReadme: Who Zethus works for, named in every spec, ADR and ruling it writes. Leave it empty in this committed file: a team's shared config must not name one person. Set it in your own ~/.copilot/zethus/config.json or this repo's untracked .copilot/zethus.config.json (identity.py --save does that), or leave it out and Zethus uses git config user.name, then the forge account, then asks you once.
_jiraReadme: Everything below is only read by the optional Jira integration skills (see docs/jira-skills.md). Leave it out entirely if you haven't installed spec-to-stories or story-enrich.
_modernizationReadme: Everything below is only read by the optional modernization extension (see docs/modernization-shared.md). Leave it out entirely if you haven't installed those skills and scripts.
